subject: Marketplace listing: support window confirmation & branding evidence
messages:
From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@contoso.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Azure Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@azure.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace prerequisites for Contoso integration

Hi Ben,

Thanks for taking this through. We're preparing the listing for Contoso's managed integration with Redwood on the Azure Marketplace and there are a couple of items that need explicit evidence before the listing can go live:

1) Support coverage window — Azure's co-sell checklist requires confirmation of a guaranteed support window and an escalation path. Can you confirm Redwood's standard support window (business hours) and whether you can provide a 24x7 option for enterprise customers? Please include SLA language we can publish on the listing.

2) Branding and claims — We need a short evidence pack showing approved marketing assets, the exact logo file(s) you intend to use, and a one-line product descriptor that matches your current docs. Azure wants to validate that copy/claims are not implying joint endorsements beyond co-sell.

3) Technical evidence — a quick checklist (post-install verification steps) so the marketplace ops team can run a basic QA.

If you can send those pieces (PDFs/screenshots/short checklist) I can attach them to the marketplace submission. We're aiming to kick the co-sell campaign the week of June 7.

Best,
Jamie Park
Partnerships Lead, Contoso Cloud
jamie.park@contoso.com

--
Attachment: contoso-integration-request.txt (1.2 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@contoso.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace prerequisites for Contoso integration

Jamie — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the pieces but want to confirm a couple of practical details to avoid back-and-forth: 

- Support windows: Redwood's default support for Marketplace customers is Mon–Fri 6am–6pm PT (business hours). We offer a paid 24x7 incident support plan on Dedicated/Enterprise contracts. For the Marketplace listing, are you asking us to publish the standard (business-hours) SLA or the paid 24x7 upgrade option? We usually publish both as options to avoid misrepresentation.

- Branding: we'll send approved PNG/SVG logo files plus the marketing one-liner. Note Azure's policy about co-branding — we must not use phrasing like "Built by Contoso and Redwood" unless the partner program explicitly approves a joint logo. We'll prepare a version that mirrors the Azure guidelines.

Attached: redwood-support-policy.pdf (contains our SLA excerpts and support contact matrix). Also linking our marketplace listing guide: https://drive.google.com/redwood/marketplace-listing-guidelines

I'll loop in Karthik (pricing & listings) and Laura (go-to-market) to confirm the exact copy and whether we can commit to a 24x7 call-out for Contoso as part of a co-sell bundle.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: redwood-support-policy.pdf (pdf, 42 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace prerequisites for Contoso integration

Ben / Laura — quick thoughts on copy and commitments below. Quoting Jamie's ask for context: 

> 1) Support coverage window — confirm Redwood's standard support window and whether 24x7 option exists.

Recommendation: Publish both items on the listing but clarify tiers. Suggested one-liner for the listing "Standard support: Mon–Fri 6am–6pm PT. Enterprise 24x7 incident support available via paid contract."

Suggested SLA excerpt for marketplace doc (short):
• Response: P1 incidents: 1 hour (24x7 customers) / Next business hour (Standard)
• Resolution: Target based on severity; enterprise customers get priority routing and dedicated escalation.

Branding: Use the "Powered by Redwood Inference" badge (we have a lightweight variant for cloud marketplaces). Laura — attaching the official badge assets here: https://drive.google.com/redwood/branding/badges (please confirm this variant is okay for Azure's UI constraints).

Operationally: we can provide the quick checklist (install, auth, sample inference call, KV cache validation) as a single-sheet Excel. Ben — I'll draft the checklist and a short script for the Marketplace QA team. 

One open item: co-sell badge approval timelines. Azure Ops often requires 5 business days for compliance checks — Jamie, will that meet your June 7 target if we get assets by May 24?

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of GTM Ops, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
